content: Hi! How can I help you with organizing or sharing your family photo scans today?
Hi! I've scanned a bunch of old family photos and videos, but the files are huge. What's the best way to send them to my siblings?

That sounds like such a meaningful project! For large files, I recommend creating a shared folder in Google Drive or Dropbox. That way, everyone can easily browse through the full-quality scans. Would you like device-specific steps to set that up?
Yes, please. I'm on Windows, and my brother uses a Mac.

Great! On Windows, open Google Drive in your browser, click 'New' > 'Folder upload,' and select your scanned files. Once uploaded, right-click the folder and choose 'Get link.' For your brother, he just needs to click the link on his Mac to browse or download the originals. Make sure the link is set to 'View only' for privacy.
Thanks! Some files are in HEIC and RAW formats. Should I convert them to JPGs or keep the originals?

If your siblings want easy viewing, converting copies to JPG is best, JPGs open smoothly across all devices. But it's wonderful to keep the originals for archiving! Maybe upload both: a 'JPG' folder for convenience and an 'Originals' folder for anyone who wants the highest quality.
Good idea. There are a couple of home videos in MP4, but they're big. Should I compress those?

MP4 is widely compatible, so that's perfect! If you'd like, you can use a tool like HandBrake to make a smaller copy for easy streaming, but keep the originals in the drive for those who want the best quality. You could label the folders as 'Watch Online' and 'Full Quality.'
How do I make sure I'm not sharing anyone's info by accident?

That's such a thoughtful question! Before sharing, quickly browse through the files, delete anything with sensitive info. When you send the folder, use a 'View only' link so no one outside your family can access or edit. For group shots, it's always nice to check with relatives before sharing more widely.
All right. The folder is uploading now. How do I let everyone know when it's ready?

Once the upload finishes, just copy the shared link and send it in your family group chat or email. You could say something like, 'Click the link to browse the album and download your favorites!' It's a lovely way to bring everyone together.
Thank you! This makes it so much easier, I'll send the link when it's done.
You're very welcome. Can't wait for your family to see those memories! If you need help organizing or labeling the folders, just let me know. Enjoy reliving those moments together!
